Rules.Rule_1: Be respectful to all members. Do not discriminate based on race, religion, gender, etc.
Rules.Rule_2: NO NSFW. Cadal and the community managers will determine if content is too graphic. If you're unsure, open a ticket.
Rules.Rule_3: Don’t harass our members. Harassment will not be tolerated.
Rules.Rule_4: Cursing is allowed, but please don’t say slurs.
Rules.Rule_5: Have common sense. If you think you shouldn’t do something, don’t do it.
Rules.Rule_7: Please refrain from discussing real-life politics.
Rules.Rule_8: Do not advertise other servers or anything of the sort without first getting approval from an admin.
Rules.Rule_9: Affiliated servers will not be moderated by our staff; however, you can still get banned for anything you say there or anywhere else, including servers, group chats, and DMs.

Punishments.Text:
Punishments will be determined on a case-by-case basis.
The severity of a punishment will be dependent on how severe a rule you broke and how many previous infractions you have.
Your first infraction will almost always be a warning.
